findings.title: Model Router Call Log Missing

evidence.observation: Model router is reachable on port 8891, but call_log_exists is false for path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service creates and writes to call_log.jsonl to maintain call traceability and auditability.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router latency, call metrics, and inference failures.

findings.title: Direct API Calls Bypass Model Router in Emergency Alert Processing

evidence.observation: Direct invocation of call_gemini and call_mistral via GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variables instead of dispatching to model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to route requests through the centralized model router endpoint.

findings.expected_benefit: Standardizes model traffic, rate limiting, and observability across intelligence pipelines.
